text: Take the chocolate box from Filecia to the Besk Family\nin Sofya via Gravel Terrace and Maia Diela.
Protect the chocolate box as you pacify Balft\nwho attacked after mistaking it for\na box of hazardous substances!
Go back to El Scaro to report and apologize to Filecia\nfor breaking the box!
Receive a new chocolate box from Filecia and\ngo to deliver it to the Besk Family in Sofya once again\nvia the same route.
Protect the box from Ruzart who attacked and\ntried to destroy it!
Fight Eidenliebe the monster indigenous to Maia Diela\nto protect Filecia and Lefina!
Since she somehow got it, let's head back to El Scaro\nto get the rewards from Filecia!
